preconditions.description: The first line of stdin contains a positive integer T representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and 4 <= N <= 10**5 for N in test_case_Ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is an integer between 4 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and abs(x) <= 10**9 for x in seq) for seq in test_case_sequences)
preconditions.description: Each sequence contains N integers where the absolute value of each element is at most 10^9.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 5*10^5.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line, N in zip(stdout_lines, test_case_Ns))
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(b[i] - b[i-1] == b[1] - b[0] for i in range(1, len(b))) for b in output_sequences)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output sequence b is an arithmetic progression (constant difference between consecutive terms).

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for i in range(len(a)) if a[i] != b[i]) <= 1 for a, b in zip(input_sequences, output_sequences))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output sequence b differs from the input sequence a in at most one position.
